dataset.transformation: Rename Resume_str to Resume; retain Resume and Category only

request.text: Accountant managing audits, financial statements and tax reporting

protocol.selection: Among methods improving pooled nested-OOF log loss AND Brier versus raw, with accuracy and macro F1 no more than 0.01 lower, minimize pooled OOF log loss; Brier breaks ties, then sigmoid. Otherwise retain raw.
protocol.threshold_selection: Maximize pooled training OOF utility: correct +1, wrong -1, abstain 0; ties higher coverage then lower T1 then lower T2. Compare no numerical abstention (0,0), retaining short-input abstention. No target accuracy or coverage.
protocol.uncertainty: short_input (<50 words) OR top_probability<T1 OR top1_minus_top2<T2; reason priority short_input, low_confidence, small_margin
protocol.ece_definition: Top-label ECE, 10 equal-width bins [lower,upper), final bin includes 1; weighted absolute bin accuracy-minus-mean-confidence; empty bins contribute zero.

calibration.legacy_contract: predicted_category, confidence and top_predictions retain raw RF semantics; calibrated_predicted_category, calibrated_confidence and calibrated_top_predictions form a separate coherent view.
calibration.limitations: Small, single-source English dataset. Isotonic can overfit with few per-class positives. Calibration may change class ranking and does not detect every out-of-domain input. Holdout previously inspected during baseline error analysis; no calibration decisions use its scores.

abstain.rule: short_input (<50 words) OR top_probability<T1 OR top1_minus_top2<T2; reason priority short_input, low_confidence, small_margin
abstain.selection: Maximize pooled training OOF utility: correct +1, wrong -1, abstain 0; ties higher coverage then lower T1 then lower T2. Compare no numerical abstention (0,0), retaining short-input abstention. No target accuracy or coverage.
abstain.limitations: Utility is an explicit demo assumption, not a validated operational cost. Thresholds are dataset-specific; tuned training coverage/accuracy are optimistic after selection.
